objective: Reject cross-platform ZIP destination collisions and non-regular entries.
scenario: An adapter archive contains one or more symlinks, duplicate destinations, case-insensitive directory-prefix collisions, or a file used as a parent of another file.
expected_behaviors: Symlinks and unsupported file types are rejected.
Duplicate and cross-platform case/Unicode path collisions are rejected.
File/directory conflicts are rejected before any extraction writes.
prohibited_behaviors: Allow one entry to overwrite another on a case-insensitive host.
